pool: V8 training pool (candidate.pkl training_sha256); EMBER2024 itself was trained elsewhere

nsis.how: approximate: the hashed section slot of '.ndata' (slot 4) has memory size with this name's sign and no data on disk, as NSIS's .ndata section does; other names in that slot can match

upx.how: approximate: hashed section slots of 'upx0' (slot 14: memory size, nothing on disk) and 'upx1' (slot 38: data on disk) both show those names' signs; other names in those slots can match

dotnet.how: .NET (CLR) data directory has a non-zero size

signature_block.how: Authenticode certificate table has a non-zero size (validity not checked)

classes_flag_note: benign_flagged_r1 / malicious_flagged_r1: files of the kind with EMBER2024 score >= r1_operating_points['fpr_0.01']
